races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: A case can be made for most of these, but preference is for SAVVY DISKO , who suffered an unpleasant fall at Glorious Goodwood when bidding for a hat-trick but got back on track at Yarmouth a couple of months ago. He can make a winning start on all-weather at the expense of Stoneacre Donny , who was edged out by a course specialist over C&D recently. Water To Wine can edge out Paddy The Squire for third. SAVVY DISKO (IRE) STONEACRE DONNY WATER TO WINE (FR)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Only a handful make any serious appeal in this big-field novice, EL RA'ADY taken to make a successful debut for powerful connections. Nip About built on his debut promise returned to a more suitable trip when runner-up over C&D and he may have to settle for silver again, with Big Money and stable-switcher Janora taken to fight out third. EL RA'ADY (IRE) NIP ABOUT BIG MONEY

races.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict: ANGELIC MELODY is drawn on the wing but shaped quite well when fourth on nursery debut at Southwell and can improve further here to get off the mark. North Coates improved when second at Musselburgh last time and is respected with the step back up to 6f likely to suit, whilst Ma Fille de Reve remains of interest on her Thirsk second. races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: HIGH THRESHOLD showed enough to win a normal race of this type when a slightly unlucky second on debut and he can go one place better. Idealise should benefit from the experience of his Kempton debut and is most feared, whilst the Gosden-trained newcomer Tabkir also makes appeal on paper. HIGH THRESHOLD (IRE) IDEALISE TABKIR

races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: SEDE VACANTE is an expensive €550,000 purchase making his debut and, being a half-brother to a 7f winner out of a dam who stayed 1¼m, is entitled to respect and can make a winning start if the market speaks in his favour. On A Boat That Day is another newcomer that makes appeal on paper, but Shimmering Shadow looks the pick of those with experience to their name. SEDE VACANTE (IRE) SHIMMERING SHADOW (IRE) ON A BOAT THAT DAY (IRE)

races.title: AWC Is Back Handicap
races.verdict: FRANKIES DREAM goes particularly well at this track and is easily excused a recent outing on soft going so he's liable to prove a real threat if things unfold well for him from stall 14. Intrusively is a recent course winner and showed better signs again last time so should be in the mix, while We Dare To Dream looks very well treated again now. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE) INTRUSIVELY WE DARE TO DREAM (IRE)

races.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: It could be worth chancing WE NEVER STOP , who often keeps better company and may be rekindled by the return to all-weather. Starmade is the obvious threat back at this venue after his encouraging third at Wolverhampton, with Lorna B another to consider having proved she's still on the upgrade after her comeback win last month.
